name: /Kaggen (the Mantis, /Xam)

domain_history.domain: trickster-creator, shapeshifting (mantis, eland, snake, louse, hare)

notes: Central figure in /Xam narrative as recorded in the Bleek-Lloyd archive; morally ambiguous, not purely benevolent. Creator of the first eland (from a piece of shoe leather, nurtured with honey); when the eland was killed by his in-laws, his tears/released gall created the first darkness. Source: Bleek and Lloyd, Specimens of Bushman Folklore (1911).
